decision_basis: User authorized the revised recommendation: all eligible material for the main comparison, identical data per method within each cohort, balanced sensitivity analyses and separate development/evaluation.
research_question_pt: Como o RAG tradicional e o RAG enriquecido por agrupamento temático se comparam na geração de oportunidades de melhoria fundamentadas em avaliações, em três estudos de caso com heterogeneidade funcional diferente?
study_design: three comparative case studies; one cohort per condition; not a causal estimate of heterogeneity

analysis_unit.operational_family: parent_asin review group with compatible functional class

cohorts.label_pt: Funções diferentes de uma rotina capilar
Funções de áreas diferentes de cuidado pessoal

sampling.duplicate_policy: existing parent_asin + normalized redacted text identity; canonical minimum rating on conflict; report conflicts, do not interpret canonical rating distribution as unchanged raw distribution
sampling.temporal_filter: no extra date cutoff; retain timestamps and describe historical coverage
sampling.selection: all eligible reviews, sorted by stable review identity; no quota in primary analysis
sampling.size_rationale: The main corpus is defined by scope and eligibility. Size is not presented as a power or saturation calculation.

development.note: Use separate families for further prompt/clustering/hyperparameter development; prior global pilot remains exploratory history.

quality_policy.generic_reviews: retain if otherwise eligible; mark limited specificity
quality_policy.version_unclear: retain at family level with lineage/uncertainty; do not attribute current catalog claims to all historical items
quality_policy.explicit_incompatible_product_type: independent review before exclusion; record reason
quality_policy.free_product_or_incentive: flag transparently; do not automatically exclude or infer fraud
quality_policy.medical_or_safety_claims: retain as attributed reports, never established efficacy or safety
quality_policy.logistics_vs_product: code separately; do not infer manufacturer responsibility from delivery complaints alone
quality_policy.privacy: retain no user_id/images; heuristic redaction plus manual residual-PII review before freezing corpus

aligned_design: three named cohorts and 15 operational families
balanced sensitivity grid with all levels reported
audit exclusion and disjoint prospective development families

primary_analysis.corpus_policy: all eligible reviews in each selected cohort after audit exclusion

sensitivity_analysis.rationale: Three feasible size levels cover a range while preserving all five families. Feasibility is checked in separate development pools before evaluation. No single level replaces the full primary corpus.
sensitivity_analysis.interpretation_limit: Controls volume and family contribution, but does not isolate all causes of heterogeneity.
